items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: we were supposed to be like the relief band for the Spanish band, Nora Morales -- they were the featured band and we were like the relief band.

ctx.x: I was a star down there, and so I

got a chance to take a band back there in 1954. I took a six piece band down there, and we were supposed to be like the relief band for the Spanish band, Nora Morales -- they were the featured band and we were like the relief band.
